title: Notification relay

relay.description: The one sending pipe: where outgoing notifications go and under what name. There is exactly one per install — it is configured, never listed.

actions.constraint: any knob alone, in any order — no step sequence exists
write-only: the saved value never returns to any screen; the UI sees a boolean
the result names what failed and the fix, never a bare red

vocabularies.digest: three fixed cadences (immediately | hourly | daily) — how often, not a schedule editor. Reopens the day quiet hours grow ranges per weekday, which is a schedule and a different control.
vocabularies.token: a secret the screen may test and replace but never read. Fails the litmus test as an object: no screen lists tokens, nothing owns more than one.

openQuestions: Whether a failed connection test should block Save. Built as: it does not — saving a config you are still fixing is normal; the test is advice, not a gate.
